findings.finding: The civilian hearing shelter does not imply an official court. Intact drying wage pages coexist with only a few cold-stove scraps in 33; no claim that all records burned.

Cold large furnace plus active small repair furnace fits limited-operation/installments framing. It cannot serve unchanged as the shift outcome (full operation), or a liquidate outcome in which the large furnace has been sold and removed. Two painted-in workers are placeholders, not guaranteed named actors present in all states.
35 shows unnamed blank tickets, matching edge treatment and a separate carbon-stained example. The press does not visibly assert an official seal.
31/35 v2 retain their visible halos; do not promote them as successful clean-alpha corrections.

overall: Drafts are usable with 34 explicitly state-scoped; no whole-batch regeneration needed.
